'''Team Rocket Pokémon''' (Japanese: '''{{j|ロケット団とポケモン}}''' ''Rocket Gang and Pokémon'') is a [[Pokémon manga]] based on the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]]. It was published daily in {{pmin|Japan}} on [[Poké Times]] from April 15 to 17, 2025. Each of its three chapters is based on a different card from the {{TCG|Glory of the Rocket Gang}} expansion and illustrated by a different artist. Each chapter is three pages long. The manga was posted on the official Asian Pokémon TCG Facebook account in English from June 1 to 3, 2025. The official social media accounts in {{pmin|Hong Kong}}, {{pmin|Taiwan}}, {{pmin|Indonesia}}, and {{pmin|Thailand}} also posted the manga in the respective local languages. ==Chapters== {| class="roundtable c" style="background:#525252; border:3px solid #932B2B" ! {{color|FFF|Chapter}} ! {{color|FFF|English title}} ! {{color|FFF|Japanese title}} ! {{color|FFF|English release}} ! {{color|FFF|Japanese release}} |- | 1 | ''[[#Team Rocket's Meowth|Team Rocket's Meowth]]'' | {{j|ロケット団のニャース}}
